cond_0001.intro: As the Senior Analyst of Learning & Development, you will partner with all areas of Human Resources in facilitating, instructing, and delivering technical, leadership, and soft skills training to new and existing employees, consistent with the business units and company-wide training policies and procedures. This role also partners closely with Restaurant Operations to deliver training solutions focused on Leadership Development. The individual in this role also provides training guidance and operational support to the Learning and Development Team.
cond_0001.responsibilities:
In addition to following [Company name masked]'s policies and procedures, principal accountabilities include, but are not limited to:
Lead in program design and management of existing and future Restaurant Operations Leadership Development programs. Proactively lead technical and soft skills training in-person and virtually, leveraging technology, to provide an interactive learning experience to employees across both the field as well as in Restaurant Support Centers (corporate offices). Design and deliver workshops and other trainings to support various departments needs across the organization. Support the new hire orientation experience for Restaurant Support Center employees. Enhance learning opportunities through train-the-trainer program for regional support partners to expand the quantity of instructional content which can be facilitated on multiple subjects to multiple markets. Collaborate with regional HRBPs to understand knowledge and performance gaps and devise custom training solutions to support business needs. Ensure employees across the country and in multiple time zones have a positive learning experience, which may include some travel and/or virtual facilitation. Provide evaluative, constructive feedback to other facilitators to ensure employees' future success. May also provide constructive feedback on process, delivery, and desired results to HR and/or other members of the team. Perform other duties as assigned.
cond_0001.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
3-5 Years of experience delivering various training in similar or related industry or business.
Knowledge and understanding of adult learning delivery methods and principles.
Experience in designing, facilitating, and evaluating leadership development content.
Ability to manage leadership development programs.
Effective project management and organizational skills.
Ability to maintain effective interpersonal relationships and communicate with cross-functional partners.
Knowledge of general human resources practices and procedures.
Preferred Requirements
Bachelor's degree in human resources or another related field (i.e., Instructional Design, Organizational Psychology/Development, HR Management, etc.).
Proficiency in [Product name masked] and [Product name masked].
Industry related experience highly desired.
3Rd party training program certifications (such as Ken Blanchard's SLII, DISC, EQ, etc.).

cond_0288.intro:
We are looking for a Sr. Analyst, Learning and Development to join our team.
As the Senior Analyst of Learning & Development, you will partner with all areas of Human Resources in facilitating, instructing, and delivering technical, leadership, and soft skills training to new and existing employees, consistent with the business units and company-wide training policies and procedures. This role also partners closely with Restaurant Operations to deliver training solutions focused on Leadership Development. The individual in this role also provides training guidance and operational support to the Learning and Development Team.
cond_0288.responsibilities:
In addition to following [Company name masked]'s policies and procedures, principal accountabilities include, but are not limited to:
Coordinate with cross-functional partners on program design and management of existing and future Restaurant Operations Leadership Development programs. Facilitate technical and soft skills training in-person and virtually, leveraging technology, to provide an interactive learning experience to employees across both the field as well as in Restaurant Support Centers (corporate offices). Work alongside various departments to design and deliver workshops and other trainings to support their needs across the organization. Support the new hire orientation experience for Restaurant Support Center employees. Expand learning opportunities through a train-the-trainer program for regional support partners to broaden the range of instructional content that can be facilitated on multiple subjects to multiple markets. Collaborate with regional HRBPs to understand knowledge and performance gaps and develop custom training solutions together to support business needs. Help ensure employees across the country and in multiple time zones have a positive learning experience, which may include some travel and/or virtual facilitation. Share evaluative, constructive feedback with other facilitators to support employees' future success. May also provide constructive feedback on process, delivery, and desired results to HR and/or other members of the team. Perform other duties as assigned.
cond_0288.requirements:
Bachelor's degree in human resources or another related field (i.e., Instructional Design, Organizational Psychology/Development, HR Management, etc.), preferred.
3-5 Years of experience delivering various training in similar or related industry or business.
Knowledge and understanding of adult learning delivery methods and principles.
Experience in designing, facilitating, and evaluating leadership development content.
Ability to manage leadership development programs.
Effective project management and organizational skills.
Proficiency in [Product name masked] and [Product name masked] preferred but not required.
Industry related experience highly desired.
3Rd party training program certifications (such as Ken Blanchard's SLII, DISC, EQ, etc.) preferred.

We are changing the face of fast food, starting conversations, and directly supporting efforts to shift the future of farming and food. We hope you will join us as we continue to learn, evolve, and shape what comes next on our mission to make better food accessible to everyone.
As the Senior Analyst of Learning & Development, you will partner with all areas of Human Resources in facilitating, instructing, and delivering technical, leadership, and soft skills training to new and existing employees, consistent with the business units and company-wide training policies and procedures. This role also partners closely with Restaurant Operations to deliver training solutions focused on Leadership Development. The individual in this role also provides training guidance and operational support to the Learning and Development Team.
cond_0480.responsibilities:
In addition to following [Company name masked]'s policies and procedures, principal accountabilities include, but are not limited to:
Lead in program design and management of existing and future Restaurant Operations Leadership Development programs. Proactively lead technical and soft skills training in-person and virtually, leveraging technology, to provide an interactive learning experience to employees across both the field as well as in Restaurant Support Centers (corporate offices). Design and deliver workshops and other trainings to support various departments needs across the organization. Support the new hire orientation experience for Restaurant Support Center employees. Enhance learning opportunities through train-the-trainer program for regional support partners to expand the quantity of instructional content which can be facilitated on multiple subjects to multiple markets. Collaborate with regional HRBPs to understand knowledge and performance gaps and devise custom training solutions to support business needs. Ensure employees across the country and in multiple time zones have a positive learning experience, which may include some travel and/or virtual facilitation. Provide evaluative, constructive feedback to other facilitators to ensure employees' future success. May also provide constructive feedback on process, delivery, and desired results to HR and/or other members of the team. Perform other duties as assigned.
cond_0480.requirements:
Bachelor's degree in human resources or another related field (i.e., Instructional Design, Organizational Psychology/Development, HR Management, etc.), or equivalent practical experience, preferred.
Around 3–5 years of experience delivering various training in a similar or related industry or business, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
Working knowledge of adult learning delivery methods and principles.
Experience in designing, facilitating, and evaluating leadership development content.
Ability to manage leadership development programs, with a willingness to develop this further on the job.
Project management and organizational skills; comfort building these in a structured environment is welcome.
Familiarity with [Product name masked] and [Product name masked] preferred but not required.
Industry-related experience is a plus.
3Rd party training program certifications (such as Ken Blanchard's SLII, DISC, EQ, etc.) preferred, or willingness to obtain.
Ability to build and maintain effective working relationships and communicate with cross-functional partners.
Background in general human resources practices and procedures.

cond_0523.intro: As the Senior Analyst of Learning & Development, you will partner with all areas of Human Resources in facilitating, instructing, and delivering technical, leadership, and soft skills training to new and existing employees, consistent with the business units and company-wide training policies and procedures. This role also partners closely with Restaurant Operations to deliver training solutions focused on Leadership Development. The individual in this role also provides training guidance and operational support to the Learning and Development Team.
cond_0523.responsibilities:
In addition to following [Company name masked]'s policies and procedures, principal accountabilities include, but are not limited to:
Lead in program design and management of existing and future Restaurant Operations Leadership Development programs. Proactively lead technical and soft skills training in-person and virtually, leveraging technology, to provide an interactive learning experience to employees across both the field as well as in Restaurant Support Centers (corporate offices). Design and deliver workshops and other trainings to support various departments needs across the organization. Support the new hire orientation experience for Restaurant Support Center employees. Enhance learning opportunities through train-the-trainer program for regional support partners to expand the quantity of instructional content which can be facilitated on multiple subjects to multiple markets. Collaborate with regional HRBPs to understand knowledge and performance gaps and devise custom training solutions to support business needs. Ensure employees across the country and in multiple time zones have a positive learning experience, which may include some travel and/or virtual facilitation. Provide evaluative, constructive feedback to other facilitators to ensure employees' future success. May also provide constructive feedback on process, delivery, and desired results to HR and/or other members of the team. Perform other duties as assigned.
cond_0523.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
3-5 Years of experience delivering various training in similar or related industry or business.
Knowledge and understanding of adult learning delivery methods and principles.
Experience in designing, facilitating, and evaluating leadership development content.
Ability to manage leadership development programs.
Effective project management and organizational skills.
Ability to maintain effective interpersonal relationships and communicate with cross-functional partners.
Knowledge of general human resources practices and procedures.
Preferred Requirements
Bachelor's degree in human resources or another related field (i.e., Instructional Design, Organizational Psychology/Development, HR Management, etc.).
Proficiency in [Product name masked] and [Product name masked].
Industry related experience highly desired.
3Rd party training program certifications (such as Ken Blanchard's SLII, DISC, EQ, etc.).

As the Senior Analyst of Learning & Development, you will regularly partner with all areas of Human Resources to facilitate, instruct, and deliver technical, leadership, and soft skills training to new and existing employees, consistent with business unit and company-wide training policies and procedures. This role also works closely and on an ongoing basis with Restaurant Operations to deliver training solutions focused on Leadership Development. The individual in this role also provides training guidance and operational support to the Learning and Development Team.
cond_0600.responsibilities:
In addition to following [Company name masked]'s policies and procedures, principal accountabilities include, but are not limited to:
Lead in program design and management of existing and future Restaurant Operations Leadership Development programs. Actively lead technical and soft skills training in-person and virtually, leveraging technology, to provide an interactive learning experience to employees across both the field as well as in Restaurant Support Centers (corporate offices). Design and deliver workshops and other trainings, connecting regularly with various departments to understand their needs across the organization. Stay engaged with the new hire orientation experience for Restaurant Support Center employees. Expand learning opportunities by working directly with regional support partners through a train-the-trainer program, so instructional content can be facilitated on multiple subjects across multiple markets. Connect with regional HRBPs on an ongoing basis to understand knowledge and performance gaps and devise custom training solutions to support business needs. Ensure employees across the country and in multiple time zones have a positive learning experience, which may include some travel and/or virtual facilitation. Provide evaluative, constructive feedback to other facilitators to ensure employees' future success. May also provide constructive feedback on process, delivery, and desired results to HR and/or other members of the team. Perform other duties as assigned.
